name: Apex Dynamics Impact-Gel Compression Layer
description:
A compression base layer with strategically placed impact-absorbing gel pads at the shoulders, elbows, hips, knees, and spine. The gel pads are soft and flexible during normal movement but harden on impact, redistributing force across a wider area. The compression fabric holds the pads precisely in position.

Worn by couriers, parkour runners, and delivery drivers who accept falling as an occupational hazard. The Impact-Gel layer turns a bone-breaking fall into a bruise-leaving tumble — not comfortable, but survivable.
functionality: Impact absorption at major joints and spine, compression fit, fall protection
what_it_says: You fall regularly enough that you've invested in making it hurt less.
story_hooks: A courier's Impact-Gel layer shows asymmetric wear patterns — all impacts on the left side, none on the right — suggesting they've been deliberately throwing themselves leftward, as though avoiding something on their right they couldn't see.
